items.situation: two students talking about a new restaurant downtown and which dish to try

conversation.speaker: Woman
conversation.text: Have you tried that new Thai place that just opened downtown?

conversation.speaker: Man
conversation.text: Not yet, but everyone on my floor keeps talking about it. Is it really worth going?

conversation.speaker: Woman
conversation.text: Honestly, yeah. I went Friday and the green curry was incredible — and not too spicy.

conversation.speaker: Man
conversation.text: Oh, that's a relief. I'm honestly pretty terrible with spicy food.

conversation.speaker: Woman
conversation.text: Then the curry's perfect for you. Just ask them to make it mild.

conversation.speaker: Man
conversation.text: Good call.

conversation.speaker: Woman
conversation.text: You'll love it. Try to go this weekend, but get there early before the crowds.

questions.stem: What are the speakers mainly discussing?

options.A: A new restaurant and what to try
options.B: How to cook a spicy Thai curry
options.D: A cooking class they both attended

questions.explanation: 对话围绕市中心新开的泰餐厅以及点哪道菜展开，所以 A 正确。B 错在他们没有讨论怎么做咖喱，只是在餐厅点菜；C 只提到男生周末会去，是次要细节而非主旨；D 完全没有出现烹饪课，属无关话题。

questions.stem: What will the man most likely do?

options.A: Cook a curry at home this weekend
options.B: Avoid the restaurant because of the spice
options.C: Order the curry and ask for it mild
options.D: Recommend the place to other friends

questions.explanation: 女生建议他点咖喱并让店家做成微辣，男生说周末会去，所以最可能是 C。A 错在他要去餐厅吃而不是在家做；B 与对话相反，女生说微辣就没问题，他并没打算避开；D 属过度推断，对话没有任何他要推荐给别人的暗示。

items.situation: two friends discussing a movie one just saw — good twists but too long

conversation.speaker: Woman
conversation.text: Did you end up seeing that new mystery film everyone's talking about?

conversation.speaker: Man
conversation.text: I did, last night. The plot twists were absolutely brilliant, honestly.

conversation.speaker: Woman
conversation.text: Everyone's been raving about those twists. So you'd recommend it, then?

conversation.speaker: Man
conversation.text: Well, sort of. The twists were great, but it dragged on for nearly three hours.

conversation.speaker: Woman
conversation.text: Three hours?

conversation.speaker: Man
conversation.text: Right. By the end I kept checking the time. Great story, just way too long.

conversation.speaker: Woman
conversation.text: That's a shame. A tighter cut would've made it perfect.

questions.stem: What is the man's overall opinion of the film?

options.A: It was boring from start to finish
options.B: It was excellent but far too long
options.C: The twists were confusing and weak
options.D: It was the best film he's seen

questions.explanation: 男生反复说剧情反转很精彩，但片长近三小时太拖沓，所以整体评价是 B——很好但太长。A 与事实相反，他并不觉得全程无聊；C 也相反，他说反转很出色而非又弱又乱；D 属夸大，他没有说这是看过最好的电影。

questions.stem: What can be inferred about the man?

options.A: He fell asleep during the film
options.B: He plans to watch it again soon
options.D: He values a tighter, shorter edit

questions.explanation: 男生抱怨影片太长、结尾频频看表，说明他更看重更紧凑更短的剪辑，故 D 正确。A 属过度推断，他只是看表并没说睡着；B 无依据，他没提要再看一遍；C 与事实相反，他明确说故事很棒。

items.situation: two friends sharing cooking tips while grocery shopping

conversation.speaker: Woman
conversation.text: Do you know how to pick a ripe avocado? Mine are always rock hard.

conversation.speaker: Man
conversation.text: Oh, easy — just press near the stem. If it gives a little, it's ready.

conversation.speaker: Woman
conversation.text: Huh, I never knew that.

conversation.speaker: Man
conversation.text: Yeah. And for tomatoes, go by smell — a ripe one smells sweet at the stem.

conversation.speaker: Woman
conversation.text: That's such a good trick. I usually just grab whatever looks reddest.

conversation.speaker: Man
conversation.text: Give the smell test a try. You'll notice the difference right away.

conversation.speaker: Woman
conversation.text: I definitely will. My salads have been so bland lately.

questions.stem: What are the two friends mainly talking about?

options.A: Which grocery store has better prices
options.B: A recipe they plan to cook together
options.C: How to tell when produce is ripe

questions.explanation: 两人一直在交流怎么判断牛油果和番茄是否成熟，所以主旨是 C。A 没有讨论哪家店更便宜；B 他们没有提到要一起做某道菜；D 与事实相反，女生并没有表示讨厌做饭，只是不会挑成熟的菜。

questions.stem: What will the woman most likely do?

options.A: Smell the tomatoes before choosing them
options.B: Ask a store employee for help

questions.explanation: 男生教她靠闻气味挑番茄，女生觉得是个好办法，所以她最可能会 A——先闻一闻再选。B 无依据，她没有说要找店员；C 属无关推断，对话没提要买预包装菜；D 属过度推断，她并没打算再也不买牛油果。

items.situation: two students chatting about a pottery class one just took

conversation.speaker: Woman
conversation.text: How was that pottery class you signed up for last month?

conversation.speaker: Man
conversation.text: Honestly, so much fun. We made bowls on the wheel the very first day.

conversation.speaker: Woman
conversation.text: Wait, already?

conversation.speaker: Man
conversation.text: Yeah, hands on right away. The teacher walks around and helps everyone individually.

conversation.speaker: Woman
conversation.text: That sounds great. Is there still space left to join?

conversation.speaker: Man
conversation.text: I think one spot's left. You should sign up tonight before it's gone.

conversation.speaker: Woman
conversation.text: Oh, I'd better hurry then. I've been wanting to try that.

questions.stem: What did the students do on the first day of class?

options.A: They watched the teacher demonstrate techniques
options.B: They painted a set of finished bowls
options.C: They picked out their own clay tools
options.D: They shaped bowls on the pottery wheel

questions.explanation: 男生明确说第一天就在拉坯机上做碗，所以 D 正确。A 是女生的错误猜测，男生说其实第一天就动手了；B 把做碗错说成给成品上色，改变了关键事实；C 提到挑选工具，对话里并没有提及，属未提及的相关项。

questions.stem: What will the woman most likely do next?

options.A: Drop the class she is in
options.B: Sign up for the pottery class
options.D: Wait until next semester to join

questions.explanation: 女生问还有没有名额，男生说只剩一个位子、让她今晚就报，所以她最可能 B——去报名。A 无依据，没提她在上别的课；C 属过度推断，她没说要买拉坯机；D 与建议相反，男生催她今晚报名以免没位。
